text:
marta: quick heads-up — proposal to change embeddings preflight behavior for oversized payloads. right now we hard-413 on >5MB bodies. idea: return a soft-reject response that includes a suggested split plan and estimated units so clients and the console can offer a guided split instead of immediate failure.

kevin: +1 on reducing user pain, curious about telemetry. would we tag soft-rejects separately so we can measure conversion to split vs outright retry?

raj: runtime implications: generating split plans on every preflight is slightly expensive (parsing + heuristic). we could do heuristic-only plan in preflight and defer precise splitting to the ingress splitter service. cost should be minimal but need latency budget.

marta: yeah plan is lightweight: detect dims and total bytes, run a greedy chunker that respects per-chunk dim-uniformity and bytes cap, return plan like: 

```json
{"chunks": [{"start": 0, "end": 256}, {"start": 256, "end": 512}], "est_units": 42}
```

kevin: can we include a header to let clients opt-out? e.g. `X-Embed-Preflight: accept-split-plan` so we only return when client asks. Some clients may prefer the old 413 behaviour.

tori: console UX: if preflight returns est_units we can surface expected cost + suggested client snippet to auto-chunk. that would be amazing for support flows. downside: we need clear copy so customers understand it's an estimate.

raj: routing concern: split plan might change which shard/pool we route to (mixed dims -> fallback runtime). Do we want preflight to also include a `route_hint` so the client can choose to route to dedicated vs hosted? that gets messy. maybe just return `compatibility: ["hosted","dedicated:gpu-a"]`

kevin: +1 on a `compatibility` field. Helps console show where each chunk would land. telemetry: tag `embed.preflight.softreject.v1` and include fields: dims, bytes, est_units, chosen_chunk_count.

marta: rollout plan idea: start opt-in flag in API+console (beta). expose a toggle in tenant settings `preflight_soft_reject`. dogfood internally. collect metrics for a week, compare client fallback rates and support tickets.

ciara-bot: integration-tests/embeddings/preflight_soft_reject failing on CI: `expected compat list non-empty` — might be related to runtime image missing the legacy routing table.

raj: ah yes forgot to wire the staging routing table into the preflight service. fixing now.

kevin: question on quotas: if we return est_units on preflight, do we charge units at preflight time? my vote: do not bill preflight, but emit an audit event so billing can be estimated in console. otherwise clients might batch preflight calls and get charged unexpectedly.

marta: agreed — preflight should be free. we will mark in spec: `note: preflight responses are advisory, non-billable` and add an audit event with `billing_estimate` only.

tori: small UX nit: console toggle should show expected reduction in 413 errors and a sample client code snippet (JS/Python) that shows how to call preflight + auto-split. I'll mock a panel.

raj: runtime fallback: if preflight indicates dims mismatch across items (mixed dims), the splitter should prefer per-item chunking rather than per-batch chunking. need unit tests for mixed-dim cases.

kevin: let's also ensure the preflight returns clear error when dims are missing in header — seen a bunch of clients not setting `X-Embed-Dims`. maybe return `400: missing-dims-hint` and include how-to in message.

marta: good call. final spec draft I will post in the docs repo, but quick API sketch: 

```http
POST /v1/embeddings:preflight
Headers: X-Embed-Dims, Content-Length
Response 200: {
  "status": "soft_reject",
  "reason": "oversize",
  "est_units": "42",
  "chunks": [...],
  "compatibility": ["hosted","dedicated:gpu-a"]
}
```

kevin: approve of fields and telemetry tags. please add a `confidence` score for est_units (low/med/high) so console can tone the messaging.

marta: will add confidence. next steps: marta -> PR for API spec, raj -> runtime patch to add routing table to staging preflight, tori -> console mock, kevin -> telemetry event schema. aim to canary behind tenant flag next week.

tori: tagging ux/design review: @tori FYI (already assigned), will ping for copy once PR lands.

raj: fix pushed to staging, re-running ci after ci failure.

ciara-bot: test run: embeddings preflight suite passed on staging image r-2026-03-22.

marta: sweet. thanks all — will open the PR and link here in a bit. :thumbsup:
